faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIMA Programme Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Programme Coordinator post at IIMA is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Programme Coordinator role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a full-time Graduation in management or any other discipline with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 3 years of experience in a suitable customer-facing role and process exposure is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Programme Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Programme Coordinator position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is available as per Government of India rules, with an additional 5 years for women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Programme Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Programme Coordinator post is based on Pay Level 2 under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the IIMA Programme Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIMA Programme Coordinator job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIMA website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Programme Coordinator post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
